description: Hi, I’m Xolile, a second-year IT student at DUT. I have skills in communication, creative thinking, problem-solving, research and teamwork, with an interest in technology and innovation. I’m looking for passionate teammates with programming, design, research and data analysis skills who are willing to collaborate, share ideas and create innovative solutions together
summary: Our project compares fire behaviour on Earth and in space using NASA data. The dashboard educates users about flames and promotes fire safety for astronauts and future space missions.
details: Our project is an interactive dashboard comparing fire behaviour on Earth and in space using NASA data. It educates users about flame behaviour, promotes fire safety and supports astronaut protection. We focused on creativity, accuracy and user-friendly design. We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript to develop it.
